quality_guards: Occupational-asthma risk depends on the sensitiser, airborne concentration, task duration, ventilation, control reliability and individual susceptibility.
Occupational-asthma guidance is exposure- and person-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Metalworking-fluid risk depends on fluid chemistry, machine enclosure, mist generation, microbial condition, skin contact, maintenance and hygiene.
Metalworking-fluid evidence is process-, machine-, fluid- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level respiratory or skin-disease probability.
Isocyanate risk depends on product chemistry, volatility, application method, enclosure, ventilation, clearance time, respiratory protection and worker sensitisation.
Isocyanate guidance is product-, task-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level asthma probability.
Flour-dust risk depends on ingredient dustiness, tipping and mixing method, automation, extraction, cleaning practice, duration and worker sensitisation.
Bakery evidence is process-, ingredient-, task- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level respiratory-disease probability.
Solder-fume risk depends on flux chemistry, iron temperature, work duration, enclosure, worker position, extraction performance and sensitisation.
Solder-fume evidence is material-, task-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level asthma probability.
Optical-radiation risk depends on wavelength, source power, beam class, exposure duration, distance, access controls, shielding and eye or skin protection.
Optical-radiation evidence is source-, task-, exposure- and person-specific and is not an exact parcel-level eye or skin-injury probability.
EMF risk depends on frequency, field strength, distance, exposure duration, work activity, shielding and the presence of implanted or body-worn medical devices.
EMF evidence is source-, task-, exposure- and person-specific and is not an exact parcel-level sensory or health-effect probability.
Pesticide risk depends on the authorised product, concentration, application rate, exposure route, equipment, weather, spray drift, storage, PPE and environmental receptors.
Pesticide evidence is product-, application-, exposure- and environment-specific and is not an exact parcel-level poisoning or ecological-harm probability.
Compressed-gas risk depends on gas properties, pressure, cylinder and valve condition, storage, ventilation, ignition sources, fire exposure, equipment compatibility and handler competence.
Compressed-gas evidence is gas-, cylinder-, equipment-, task- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire, explosion or injury probability.
Permit effectiveness depends on the specific hazard, isolation standard, competence, simultaneous operations, shift handover, document clarity, monitoring and close-out discipline.
Permit-to-work evidence is activity-, hazard-, plant-, isolation- and management-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
